**Date:** [Insert Date]

To Whom It May Concern,

I am writing to formally document that I am currently under medical care and will be undergoing a necessary surgical procedure, which requires a period of recovery and absence from work.

Due to the nature of this procedure, I will be medically unable to perform my professional duties for an estimated recovery period of approximately [6–12 weeks, or as directed by physician]. During this time, I will be prioritizing my health and adhering to all medical guidance to ensure a full and proper recovery.

This leave is not discretionary but medically required. I will not be available for work-related responsibilities, communications, or obligations during the initial stages of recovery, as advised by my healthcare provider.

I will provide updates as appropriate regarding my return-to-work timeline, based on medical clearance and recovery progress.

Thank you for your understanding and consideration during this time.

Sincerely,  

**Bethany Anne Gifford**

**Patient Name:** Elizabeth Gifford  
**Date of Birth:** 02/25/1983  
**Patient ID:** 316479  

**Date:** March 17, 2026  

To Whom It May Concern,

This letter is to confirm that the above-named patient is under medical care and requires a temporary leave of absence from work due to a medical procedure and necessary recovery period.

The patient is to remain off work from **March 17, 2026 through April 7, 2026**.

Following this initial recovery period, the patient may return to work in a **remote capacity only** for an additional **3 to 6 weeks**, depending on recovery progress. Continued remote work or extension of these restrictions may be required if the patient has not sufficiently recovered, as determined by medical evaluation.

These restrictions are medically necessary to support proper healing and prevent complications.

If you have any questions or require further documentation, please contact the medical office.

Sincerely,
